request.prompt: Instrumental adventurous anime naval skirmish theme with warm human-scale courage. Shipgirl companions face a worthy rival fleet, clever maneuvers and mutual trust. A catchy clarinet tune with bold rhythmic contours, sparse piano chord replies, warm horn melodic answers and softly moving low strings. Light measured percussion keeps forward motion. Clear question-and-answer phrases, a short reflective tactical contrast and a confident varied return. Complete two-minute compact melody-led structure, brighter major harmony with brief tension and relief. Friendship expressed through musical dialogue, still a battle rather than a peaceful port stroll. Avoid whimsical nursery figures, shrill flute runs and dense cinematic layers. Keep ending in active thematic motion for future body-loop work. Music only, entirely instrumental: no voices, choir, speech, ocean ambience or weapon sounds. Clear melodic lead and quiet supporting parts, natural acoustic tone, comfortable midrange, restrained dynamics and coherent connected phrases.
